description: Authenticators do not meet minimum strength requirements for the security level of the systems they protect. This signal indicates that weak authentication mechanisms may be in use for sensitive systems.
applicability: Applicable to all authentication mechanisms. Includes password complexity, cryptographic key strength, certificate algorithms, and multi-factor authenticator requirements.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through password policy review, cryptographic algorithm assessment, and authenticator strength testing.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 - Identification and Authentication
32 CFR Part 170 - Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification Program
